senses.zh_definition: 专名 Izaki，可见于人名，已有作为日本姓氏的用例；输入未提供足以确定具体人物的上下文。
senses.en_definition: A proper name attested as a Japanese surname; the intended bearer is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang antaranya digunakan sebagai nama keluarga Jepun; individu yang dimaksudkan tidak dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 本项不是已核实的马来语普通词条，故不标记为 official。姓氏用例可见[神户大学学术成果库](https://da.lib.kobe-u.ac.jp/da/kernel/81002849/)。这不证明输入专指该作者。下列搭配是用法模板，未验证频率；排名沿用输入数据。

etymology.historical_story: Names can travel into Malay texts without becoming Malay vocabulary. Izaki is attested as a surname in Japanese academic records, but this packet supplies neither an original script nor a particular bearer. Its appearance therefore supports a proper-name entry, not an invented Malay meaning or a definite account of its ancestral spelling. [Kobe University repository](https://da.lib.kobe-u.ac.jp/da/kernel/81002849/)
